022/**
023 * Verifiable code examples for StreamConverter documentation.
024 *
025 * <p>This class contains actual, compilable, and runnable code examples that are referenced from
026 * documentation. Each example is marked with START/END comments for potential extraction into
027 * documentation.
028 *
029 * <p>All examples in this file are tested to ensure they compile and execute correctly.
030 */
031public class BasicUsageExamples {
032
033  // [START csv-navigate-basic]
034  /**
035   * CSV navigation pipeline example - demonstrates pipeline structure with CSV column navigation.
036   * Note: Uses PassThroughRule (no transformation) and a lambda pass-through (placeholder for
037   * actual processing).
038   */
039  public void csvNavigateBasic() throws Exception {
040    // Sample CSV data
041    String csvData = "id,productName,price\n" + "1,Apple,100\n" + "2,Banana,50\n";
042    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
043    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
044
045    // Create pipeline: navigate CSV + process
046    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
047      new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("productName"), new PassThroughRule()),
048      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
049    };
050
051    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
052    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
053  }
054
055  // [END csv-navigate-basic]
056
057  // [START csv-filter-basic]

093      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
094    };
095
096    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
097    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);

126  /**
127   * Character encoding conversion pipeline example - demonstrates charset conversion in a pipeline.

130  public void characterConvertBasic() throws Exception {
131    String data = "Hello World";

134
135    // Create pipeline: convert encoding + process
136    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {

138      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
139    };
140
141    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
142    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);

152  public void lineEndingNormalizeBasic() throws Exception {

169  // [START pipeline-simple]
170  /** Simple pipeline example - chaining multiple commands. */
171  public void simplePipeline() throws Exception {
172    String csvData = "id,name,price\n1,Apple,100\n";
173    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes("Shift_JIS"));
174    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
175
176    // CSV → Character conversion → Output
177    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
178      new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
179      new CharacterConvertCommand("Shift_JIS", "UTF-8")
180    };
181
182    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
183    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
184  }
185
186  // [END pipeline-simple]
187
188  // [START error-handling-basic]
189  /**
190   * Error handling pipeline example - demonstrates exception-based error detection. Note: The
191   * lambda pass-through is a placeholder for actual processing logic.
192   */
193  public void errorHandlingBasic() throws Exception {
194    String csvData = "id,name\n1,Apple\n";
195    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
196    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
197
198    // Create pipeline for error handling demonstration
199    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
200      new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
201      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
202    };
203
204    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
205    try {
206      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
207    } catch (StreamProcessingException e) {
208      System.err.println("Pipeline failed: " + e.getMessage());
209      throw e;
210    }
211  }
212  // [END error-handling-basic]
213}
